stem: Aarav is explaining human digestion of complex food components such as carbohydrates, proteins and fats along the alimentary canal from mouth to anus.

parts.text: Which claim about digestion is correct?

options.text: Digestion breaks complex food into simpler forms along the alimentary canal from mouth to anus.
Digestion joins simple food substances into complex substances the body can use.
All digestion takes place only in the stomach.
Digestion is only the absorption of nutrients into the blood.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Digestion is breakdown of complex food into simpler forms along the canal, not joining, stomach-only work, or absorption alone.

teacher.key_rationale: Digestion breaks complex food into simpler forms along the alimentary canal; absorption is a later step.
